study: Retrospective task-specific BRDF benefit/cost benchmark; prior project results are known, not a preregistered trial
primary_endpoints: identity-balanced held-site recognition where all classes remain supported

contrasts.drone_primary: 10percent mask: combined SCS+C+BRDF versus same topographic-only model on exact shared field-polygon pixels; isolates incremental BRDF conditional on topo/mask
contrasts.drone_sensitivity: baseline unmasked combined diagnostic versus same topographic-only fit, preserving failed Ruby QA; raw and BRDF-only arms reported with their availability/QA, not chosen by score
contrasts.aop_archive: Same-row raw versus archived BRDF+topography combined; retrospective pipeline contrast, not BRDF-only attribution; Gaussian OLI-like projection before polygon medians
contrasts.aop_control: Bounded R10C real-angle window, current BRDF-only algorithm,20m spatial-group holdout; angular diagnostics, no PFT or absolute calibration claim
contrasts.landsat: Same current HLS cells and grid: HLS NBAR versus reconstructed pre-NBAR by inversion of official global-coefficient c-factor using actual SAA/SZA/VAA/VZA and NBAR_SOLAR_ZENITH metadata; not original C2 reconstruction

main_features: five common OLI-like channels B1-B5; seven-band AOP/Landsat sensitivity
repeated_units: AOP GlobalID histories never cross folds; drone GlobalID; Landsat spatial patch, not cell
classifier: training-only StandardScaler + balanced logistic C1 fixed, five grouped identity folds where supported and leave-site/domain out; no tuning on outcomes
statistics: 9999 paired whole-identity swaps, exact whole-domain swaps and1999 true-class-stratified identity bootstrap intervals; site dependence limits inference; NPC complete-curve labels within sites, Holm over declared run family
comparisons: All feasible prespecified arm/sensor/feature/evaluation contrasts archived; primary/family membership fixed before comparing results; unsupported folds explicit NA, not zero
practical_interpretation: Report percentage-point gains/conditional95percent intervals, correction magnitude, QA loss and recorded runtime.2pp and5pp may be shown as illustrative decision thresholds, not universal standards. Human labour not measured.
precision: HLS inverse inherits original NBAR integer quantization; reconstructed directional error bounded by half a1e-4stored step/cfactor only for unclipped samples, not independent accuracy validation
exclusions: Only declared source NoData, finite common support and source QA. No removal by effect direction, PFT score or model residual; finite negative values are not automatically invalid.
conditioning: No new purity labels, sensor response defaults, BRDF/topographic coefficients or production guards changed. Drone radiometry conditional; HLS PFT labels unvalidated, regional confounding retained.
execution: Read supplied library in place; stream contiguous flightlines in8192-row batches, immediately reduce to compact polygons/paired-view statistics; no ordinary pixel-scale cache. Separate stage checkpoints keyed to input/code hashes.
